mapper.insert: insert into dish (name, category_id, price, image, description, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user, status) values (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{image}, #{description}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser}, #{status})
mapper.update:
update dish
name = #{name},
category_id = #{categoryId},
price = #{price},
image = #{image},
description = #{description},
status = #{status},
update_time = #{updateTime},
update_user = #{updateUser},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select d.*, c.name as categoryName from dish d left join category c on d.category_id = c.id where d.category_id = #{categoryId} and d.status = 1
select count(id) from dish where category_id = #{categoryId}

select count(id) from dish
and status = #{status}
